name: Spirokai
description: Akron Legionnaire who feels no pain and buried the Abuser.

description_citations.text: "Vacar Slab". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ophelia frees the Abuser; Spirokai buries him, a zombified Teeth strikes Spirokai, and Ophelia leaves alone.
timeline.quote: Ophelia, now the sole apparent survivor, but carrying both a weapon and water, leaves Vacar Slab alone.

citation.text: "Distant Planes", section "The Old Way to Vacar Slab , by Michael G. Ryan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In a sandstorm Ophelia freed Markus; Spirokai caught them and buried Markus up to the neck.
timeline.quote: Spirokai caught them though, and buried Markus up to the neck.

citation.text: "Markus", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A zombified Teeth slashed Spirokai in the head and became a mummy.
timeline.quote: a zombified Teeth showed up and slashed Spirokai in the head with his sword

citation.text: "Markus", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Before dying, Markus told Ophelia his name; Ophelia left alone while Spirokai began to claw his way out.
timeline.quote: Before dying, the Abuser told Ophelia his name was Markus

citation.text: "Markus", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Spirokai led a team escorting the Abuser to Vacar Slab, and members began dying on the perilous journey.
timeline.quote: The journey was perilous, and the party members started dying sequentially.

citation.text: "Spirokai", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In a sandstorm Ophelia freed the Abuser and tried to escape; Spirokai caught them and buried the Abuser up to the neck.
timeline.quote: Ophelia freed the Abuser and tried to escape

citation.text: "Spirokai", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zombified Teeth slashed Spirokai in the head, then wrapped himself in bandages to become a mummy.
timeline.quote: he wrapped himself up in the last of their bandages, becoming a mummy

citation.text: "Spirokai", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ophelia left Vacar Slab alone while Spirokai began to claw his way out.
timeline.quote: Spirokai had survived both his head wound and being buried alive, and started to claw his way out.

citation.text: "Spirokai", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In a sandstorm Ophelia frees the Abuser, but Spirokai catches them and buries him to the neck.
timeline.quote: Spirokai caught them, though, and buried the Abuser up to the neck.

citation.text: "Vacar Slab", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A zombified Teeth slashes Spirokai in the head and then wraps himself in bandages, becoming a mummy.
timeline.quote: a zombified Teeth showed up and slashed Spirokai in the head with his sword

citation.text: "Vacar Slab", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ophelia leaves alone while Spirokai starts to claw his way out.
timeline.quote: Spirokai had survived both his head wound and being buried alive, and started to claw his way out

citation.text: "Vacar Slab", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: betrayed him by freeing the prisoner
relations.quote: He was about to do the same to Ophelia for betraying him
